A little elf with a scarf was eating a loaf of bread. Two elves joined him with more bread. “We need some knives to cut our loaves,” they said. Then, some thieves grabbed their scarves and knives. They left the loaves cut in halves on the shelves. So the elves had no knives, but they still had their lives and the loaves for themselves. Un pequeño elfo con una bufanda estaba comiendo una hogaza de pan. Dos elfos se unieron a él con más pan. “Necesitamos unos cuchillos para cortar nuestras hogazas”, dijeron. Luego, unos ladrones agarraron sus bufandas y cuchillos. Dejaron las hogazas cortadas por la mitad en los estantes.
